input.title: Women's Christmas – I Did Christmas. Again. Long Sleeve Tee
input.descriptionHtml:
The Story

I Did Christmas. Again. The mom's piece of our matching family Christmas shirts set, for the Christmas-morning photo: she did the shopping, the wrapping and the tree, and says so with a straight face.

The art is a 1950s Christmas-card scene: a cheerful, slightly lopsided decorated Christmas tree in a living room corner with big-bulb lights sagging off one branch, a few wrapped presents on a red rug (one with its bow missing and a torn corner), a wooden stepladder leaning beside it, and a small stool holding a candy cane and a tipped glass of milk with a half-eaten cookie. I DID CHRISTMAS. runs across the top and AGAIN. stacks across the bottom, in heavy deep-red and pine-green capitals on White and in cream and mustard capitals on Red, where the scene also gets a cream outline.

Wear it to Christmas morning, the family photo or the cookie swap, and pair it with the Dad, Kid and Baby pieces of the Christmas Credits set. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Regular fit, crew neck, long sleeves with 2 in ribbed cuffs
  • 100% Airlume combed, ring-spun cotton
  • Fabric weight: 4.2 oz/yd² — lightweight
  • Side-seamed construction, cover-stitched collar
  • Sizes XS–2XL
  • 2 colors: White, Red
  • Blank product sourced from Nicaragua, Honduras, or the US

Questions

How does it fit?
This adult long sleeve tee is a Bella+Canvas 3501 in sizes XS through 2XL. Order your usual size for a regular fit or go up one for a roomier look. Compare the size chart with a piece you already own, and Graphic Tees Co. offers one free size exchange within 30 days of delivery.

What is it made of and how do I wash it?
It is 100% Airlume combed, ring-spun cotton at a lightweight 4.2 oz/yd², with side seams, a cover-stitched collar and 2-inch ribbed cuffs. From Graphic Tees Co.: turn it inside out, wash it cold with similar colors and tumble dry low. Skip bleach so the red, green and mustard inks stay bright, and do not iron over the print.

What colors does it come in and how is it printed?
It comes in White and Red, the two colors the whole set shares. On White the headline is deep red and AGAIN. pine green; on Red they turn to cream and mustard with a cream outline around the scene. Graphic Tees Co. prints each one to order.

Is there a matching set?
Yes. This is Mom's piece of the Christmas Credits family set; Dad, the kids and the baby each get their own line on the same tree art, each on its own page, and White and Red are the colors all four share so the photo matches.

Who is it a good gift for?
It suits the mom who runs Christmas, a sister who does the same job, or whoever is organizing the family photo. Graphic Tees Co. prints it to order, orders of $45 or more ship free, and the free size exchange within 30 days covers a wrong guess on size.

When should I order it for Christmas?
Order by about December 8 so it arrives before Christmas. Each piece is printed to order, which takes a few business days, then ships within the US. A misprint or damaged item is reprinted or refunded within 30 days, and orders of $45 or more ship free.
